_comment: One rule set per customer. Copy this file to app/rules/<customer_id>.json and edit. Each field's 'match' is one of: 'exact' (normalized equality), 'fuzzy' (token_set_ratio >= threshold AND all expected words present), or 'format' (regex via 'pattern', or a built-in named 'format' like 'weight'). 'expected' holds the reference value; 'expected_description' is a human-readable label shown for format fields.

gross_weight.expected_description: a number followed by a weight unit, e.g. 1,250.00 KGS
